title: Regulating Act 1773 to Act of 1786
quote: 1773 began Parliamentary control; 1784 set the dual system that lasted until 1858

boxes.title: Background to the 1773 Act
steps: **1765**: **Shah Alam** grants **Diwani** of Bengal, Bihar, Orissa
==**Regulating Act 1773**==: first Parliamentary control of the Company

boxes.title: Regulating Act, 1773
items: ==**First step by British Parliament to control the Company**==
Governor of Bengal → **GG of Bengal**; Bombay and Madras subordinated
**Supreme Court at Calcutta (1774)**: **1 Chief Justice + 3 judges**; civil + criminal
Court of Directors to report revenue, civil, military affairs to British Government
Did **not** abolish the Court of Directors

boxes.title: Acts compared
head: Act
Key provision
rows: GG, Council, servants exempt for official acts; revenue excluded; personal laws respected
**Board of Control**; stricter supervision; dual system till **1858**
Override power extended to presidency governors

boxes.title: Defects of 1773 → remedies
head: Defect
Remedy
rows: GG had **no veto**; outvoted by council (**Hastings**)
Supreme Court jurisdiction undefined → Council-Court clashes

boxes.title: AP angle: courts in Andhra
items: **Sadar Adalat** and **Sadar Faujdari Adalat** for others

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: APPSC 2019 "incorrect statement": 1773 Act ==did **not** abolish Court of Directors==
**1781** = Act of Settlement (curbs Supreme Court); **1786** = override power (Cornwallis)
Ministry of Law and Justice traced to **Charter Act 1833**, not 1773
